issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error handling or edge cases such as failed configuration tests or missing certificates.

scenarios.name: reverse-proxy-with-tls-and-rate-limit
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies all rubric requirements, while Response B provides no content.

scenarios.name: load-balancer-with-health-checks
scenarios.rationale: Response A meets several rubric items (upstream, keepalive, proxy settings) but lacks the required name, least_conn, and backup server; Response B misses most rubric items.

scenarios.name: static-spa-serve-with-caching
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items (gzip, headers, SPA fallback, long‑term caching) but omits sendfile on and short caching for non‑HTML files; Response B lacks sendfile, proper short caching, and the required security headers.
